description: Claim form filed by the nominee or legal heir of a deceased EPFO member to claim the Provident Fund balance after the member's death.

fields.name: Claimant Name (Nominee / Legal Heir)
fields.description: Full name of the person claiming the PF balance of the deceased.

fields.name: Claimant's Father's / Husband's Name
fields.description: Claimant's own father's or husband's name — for identification.

fields.name: Claimant's Address
fields.description: Full permanent residential address of the claimant, along with PIN code.

fields.name: Relationship to Deceased
fields.description: How are you related to the deceased? (Wife/Husband/Son/Daughter/Mother/Father etc.)

fields.name: Name of Deceased Member
fields.description: Full name of the EPFO member who has passed away.

fields.name: PF Account Number / UAN of Deceased
fields.description: The Universal Account Number or PF account number of the deceased.

fields.name: Establishment Name where Deceased Worked
fields.description: Name of the company/factory where the deceased was employed last.

fields.name: Date of Death
fields.description: Exact date of death of the member in DD/MM/YYYY format.

fields.name: Cause of Death
fields.description: Brief mention: Natural / Accident / Disease etc.

fields.name: Bank Account Number of Claimant
fields.description: Active bank account number of the claimant where payment should be credited.

fields.name: IFSC Code
fields.description: IFSC code of the bank branch for the claimant's account.

fields.name: Mode of Payment
fields.description: Select: ECS / NEFT / DD. ECS (online bank transfer) is preferred.

fields.name: Claimant's Signature / Thumb Impression
fields.description: Signature or left thumb impression of the claimant with date.

fields.name: Certificate by Employer / Magistrate
fields.description: Certification by the last employer confirming employment and death. If employer is unavailable, a Gazette Officer or Magistrate can certify.
